sentences.en: Thousands of pages of newly released emails between Jeffrey Epstein and his friends and associates
sentences.zh: 数千页杰弗里·爱泼斯坦与其朋友及合伙人之间新公开的电子邮件

sentences.en: have put the financier's relationship with President Trump back into the spotlight.

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues David Enrich and Michael Gold on what these new documents tell us and whether they could trigger the release of the rest of the Epstein files.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事大卫·恩里奇和迈克尔·戈德将探讨这些新文件告诉了我们什么，以及它们是否会促使爱泼斯坦档案的其余部分被公开。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, November 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月13日，星期四。

sentences.en: So David, you're back on the show to talk to us about the latest chapter in this ongoing saga about the relationship between Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 大卫，欢迎回到节目，和我们聊聊关于唐纳德·特朗普和杰弗里·爱泼斯坦之间关系这一持续传奇的最新篇章。

sentences.en: And today, Wednesday, it seems like there was a very meaningful update to our understanding about that relationship.
sentences.zh: 今天，也就是周三，我们对这种关系的理解似乎有了非常有意义的更新。

sentences.en: But can you just break it down for us?
sentences.zh: 你能为我们梳理一下吗？

sentences.en: How significant were the revelations that came out today?
sentences.zh: 今天披露的内容有多重要？

sentences.en: Extremely significant, I would say.
sentences.zh: 我认为非常重要。

sentences.en: OK, walk us through what happened.
sentences.zh: 好的，带我们了解一下发生了什么。

sentences.en: So we woke up this morning to the news that Democrats on the House Oversight Committee had released three emails from Jeffrey Epstein's email account
sentences.zh: 今天早上我们醒来时得知，众议院监督委员会的民主党人公布了三封来自杰弗里·爱泼斯坦邮箱的邮件，

sentences.en: in which he and others were talking about Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 邮件中他和别人谈论了唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And the emails appeared to show that Epstein recognized that he had some important information about his relationship with Trump and Trump's relationship with women or girls.
sentences.zh: 这些邮件似乎显示，爱泼斯坦意识到他掌握了一些关于他与特朗普的关系，以及特朗普与女性或女孩关系的重要信息。

sentences.en: And just as we were all starting to kind of decipher the cryptic wording in those messages, the Republicans on the House Oversight Committee one-upped their Democratic counterparts
sentences.zh: 就在我们开始解读这些信息中隐晦措辞的时候，众议院监督委员会的共和党人抢先一步，

sentences.en: and released additional Epstein-related emails, many of which are also about Donald Trump or at least mentioned Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 公布了更多与爱泼斯坦相关的邮件，其中许多也与唐纳德·特朗普有关，或者至少提到了他。

sentences.en: And so we've been spending what feels like an eternity today going through these emails one by one, reading them, trying to make sense of them,
sentences.zh: 所以我们今天花了一整天的时间，感觉像过了一个世纪，逐一阅读这些邮件，试图理解它们，

sentences.en: and trying to understand their implications for Trump and his administration.
sentences.zh: 并试图了解它们对特朗普及其政府的影响。

sentences.en: OK, let's go one by one and start with the beginning of the day, the first emails that you saw.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们逐一来看，从今天早上的第一封邮件开始。

sentences.en: Can you tell us what those emails were?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们那些邮件是什么吗？

sentences.en: Sure, I can read them to you.
sentences.zh: 当然，我可以读给你听。

sentences.en: I've got them in front of me if you want me to.

sentences.en: Yes, please.

sentences.en: OK, so there's three of them.
sentences.zh: 好的，一共有三封。

sentences.en: The first is from April of 2011.
sentences.zh: 第一封来自2011年4月。

sentences.en: And this is a time just contextually when Epstein had only recently been released from house arrest as part of his punishment for having solicited prostitution from a minor.
sentences.zh: 从背景来看，当时爱泼斯坦因诱导未成年人卖淫而服刑，刚结束居家监禁不久。

sentences.en: He's seeking to kind of repair his reputation, and he's thinking about trying to get his guilty plea overturned.
sentences.zh: 他试图修复自己的名誉，并考虑推翻自己的认罪协议。

sentences.en: And he writes to his longtime associate, Ghislaine Maxwell,
sentences.zh: 他写信给他的长期合伙人吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦，

sentences.en: I want you to realize that the dog that has not barked is Trump.
sentences.zh: “我要你意识到，那条没叫的狗就是特朗普。”

sentences.en: And then there's a victim's name redacted.
sentences.zh: 后面是一个被涂黑的受害者名字。

sentences.en: She spent hours at my house with him.
sentences.zh: “她在他家和我待了几个小时。”

sentences.en: He has never once been mentioned.
sentences.zh: “他从来没被提过一次。”

sentences.en: Ghislaine Maxwell responds, I have been thinking about that.
sentences.zh: 吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦回复道：“我一直在想这件事。”

sentences.en: And Trump at this point is a reality TV star in 2011 who has these vague and kind of unrealistic presidential ambitions.
sentences.zh: 2011年的特朗普是一位真人秀明星，有着模糊且不切实际的总统野心。

sentences.en: But it's a little unclear why at that point Epstein thought that the information he had on Trump was relevant.
sentences.zh: 但目前还不清楚为什么爱泼斯坦当时认为他掌握的关于特朗普的信息是有意义的。

sentences.en: And so we are all left wondering exactly what this means.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都想知道这到底意味着什么。

sentences.en: And just so I understand, the dog that hasn't barked is Trump means or implies that there's some kind of information that hasn't been made public.
sentences.zh: 为了确认我理解正确，“那条没叫的狗就是特朗普”是指或暗示有一些尚未公开的信息吗？

sentences.en: And so this email is interesting because it suggests that Epstein knows things about Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以这封邮件很有趣，因为它暗示爱泼斯坦知道关于特朗普的事情。

sentences.en: Do I have that right?

sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦似乎认为他掌握了一些关于特朗普的、尚未公开的信息，这些信息可能对他有用。

sentences.en: Or at least he's trying to portray that he does.

sentences.en: So the next email is from December of 2015, and it's between Epstein and a journalist named
sentences.zh: 下一封邮件来自2015年12月，是爱泼斯坦和一位名叫迈克尔·沃尔夫的记者之间的通信，

sentences.en: And this takes place right as CNN is planning to air a debate involving the Republican presidential candidates, including Trump.
sentences.zh: 这发生在CNN计划播出共和党总统候选人辩论（包括特朗普）的前夕。

sentences.en: And Wolff, he says he hears that CNN is going to ask Trump about his relationship with Epstein.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫说他听说CNN要问特朗普关于他和爱泼斯坦的关系。

sentences.en: Epstein then responds, if we were able to craft an answer for him, what do you think it should be?
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦随后回复：“如果我们能为他编造一个答案，你觉得应该是什么？”

sentences.en: Wolff then responds to that in a very telling way, which is, I think you should let him hang himself.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫随后以一种非常耐人寻味的方式回复道：“我觉得你应该让他自掘坟墓。”

sentences.zh: “如果他说他没上过那架飞机也没去过那栋房子，那就能给你带来宝贵的

sentences.en: Michael Wolff, of course, is a journalist who's authored multiple books about President

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 你如何看待他在那一刻似乎在给爱泼斯坦提供公关建议这件事？

sentences.zh: 这不是记者传统的工作方式。

sentences.zh: 看，爱泼斯坦和特朗普的关系，我们在2025年了解很多，但在十年前，我们几乎一无所知。

sentences.zh: 他们有时甚至在追求同一个年轻女性。

sentences.en: And what we now know is that Trump in the 80s and 90s and into the early 2000s was pretty good friends with Epstein, and they were moving in the same social circles.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在2015年特朗普职业生涯的这个阶段，他显然非常出名。

sentences.en: They were both pursuing at points some of the same young women.
sentences.zh: 但很多后来定义了他及其与女性关系的事情，比如E·简·卡罗尔的指控或《走进好莱坞》录音带，在当时都还未发生。

sentences.en: So, you know, at this point in Trump's career in 2015, he is obviously very well known.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为从爱泼斯坦的角度来看，他有大量与特朗普相处的经验，看到他与女性的互动，我认为这就是爱泼斯坦在2015年坐在那里时，

sentences.en: And so I think from Epstein's perspective, the fact that he has a lot of experience having been around Trump and seeing him interacting with women, I think that that is the kind

sentences.en: that he could use to gain some sort of leverage over this guy who is all of a sudden a leading candidate to become president of the United States.

sentences.en: And so there's a certain amount here that we know contextually what he's referring to.

sentences.zh: 麦克斯韦回复道：“我一直在想这件事。”

sentences.en: I'm not sure I would use the word contradict, but there's certainly some tension here.
sentences.zh: 这当然暗示麦克斯韦知道关于特朗普的一些事情。

sentences.en: I mean, in the 2011 email that Epstein sent to Maxwell, he refers to an unknown victim as having spent hours at my house, meaning Epstein's house, with Trump.
sentences.zh: 可能有一些看似合理的解释，使得这与她今年夏天对司法部的说法并不矛盾。

sentences.en: And Maxwell responds to that, I have been thinking about that.
sentences.zh: 但从表面上看，确实存在一些张力。

sentences.en: And that certainly implies that Maxwell knew about something that was going on with Trump.
sentences.zh: 好的，你刚才带我们梳理了民主党人公布的三封邮件。

sentences.en: There are potentially some, I guess, plausible explanations in which that does not contradict what she said this summer to the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: But there's certainly on their face does seem to be some tension.
sentences.zh: 接下来发生的是，众议院监督委员会的共和党人公布了我们粗略统计超过20,000页来自杰弗里·爱泼斯坦Gmail账户的邮件。

sentences.en: OK, so you've just walked us through the three emails released by Democrats.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我们可能只看完了三分之一或四分之一。

sentences.en: What happened next?
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道全部内容会显示什么。

sentences.en: What happened next is that the Republicans on the House Oversight Committee released, by our best count, more than 20,000 pages of emails from Jeffrey Epstein's Gmail account.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，主要的结论是，很明显在特朗普与爱泼斯坦断绝关系多年后，爱泼斯坦仍然非常关注特朗普。

sentences.en: We're frankly, I would say we're maybe a third or a quarter of the way through going through all these emails.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎至少有两个原因。

sentences.en: So I do not know what the totality of it is going to show.
sentences.zh: 一是他在试图伤害唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: But so far, the main takeaway is that it's really clear that for years after Trump severed his ties with Epstein, Epstein was still really focused on Trump.
sentences.zh: 他在诋毁他的生意。

sentences.en: And it seemed like for at least two reasons.
sentences.zh: 他在诋毁特朗普的人格。

sentences.en: One is that he was trying to hurt Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但其次，特别是在后期，爱泼斯坦似乎认为他在联邦政府（由唐纳德·特朗普领导）对爱泼斯坦进行刑事调查时，对特朗普拥有潜在的筹码。

sentences.en: He was disparaging his businesses.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到爱泼斯坦称特朗普为“笨蛋”和“痴呆”的邮件。

sentences.en: He was disparaging Trump's character.
sentences.zh: 但我们也看到他敦促律师或财务顾问深入挖掘特朗普财务状况的邮件。

sentences.en: But secondly, especially in later years, Epstein appeared to think that he had some potential leverage over Trump at a time when the federal government,
sentences.zh: 我们从其他报道中得知，爱泼斯坦总是试图将自己描绘成能接触到某些人，而实际上他可能并没有接触渠道，或者关系并没有他描述的那么亲密。

sentences.en: which was run by Donald Trump, was criminally investigating Epstein.
sentences.zh: 在目前我们看到的所有这些邮件中，他似乎都在试图利用人们对他与唐纳德·特朗普关系亲密的看法作为筹码。

sentences.en: And so we see emails where Epstein is calling Trump a dope and demented.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But we also see emails where he is urging his lawyer or his financial advisor to dig into Trump's finances.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，基于我们对爱泼斯坦交易作风的了解，我们应该多大程度上相信爱泼斯坦对自己与唐纳德·特朗普关系的描述？

sentences.en: We know from other reporting that Epstein was constantly trying to portray himself as having access to people that maybe he didn't actually have access to or he wasn't as close with as he portrayed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为任何人都不应该太相信杰弗里·爱泼斯坦所说或所写的内容。

sentences.en: And it seems here in all these emails that we've seen so far that he's trying to leverage the perception of his proximity to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: And I just wonder, based on what we know about how transactional Epstein was, how much stock should we put into the way that Epstein is portraying his relationship to Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: Well, I don't think anyone should ever put much stock into what Jeffrey Epstein says or writes.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: He is a complete liar with a really clear pattern of manipulating people for his own gain and exaggerating his connections to powerful people.
sentences.zh: 他是个彻头彻尾的骗子，有着非常明显的行为模式：为了自身利益操纵他人，并夸大自己与权势人物的关系。

sentences.en: That said, we have, through our reporting and other news organizations reporting,
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，通过我们的报道以及其他新闻机构的报道，

sentences.en: we've clearly established over and over again that Trump and Epstein were quite close for a period of time.
sentences.zh: 我们已经多次明确证实，特朗普和爱泼斯坦在一段时间内确实走得很近。

sentences.en: But to me, the takeaway of these emails is not so much what they reveal about Epstein's relationship with Trump as much as they reveal that Epstein,
sentences.zh: 但在我看来，这些邮件的重点不在于它们揭示了爱泼斯坦与特朗普之间的关系，而在于它们揭示了爱泼斯坦，

sentences.en: who was always an opportunist and always looking for an edge over people, was doing that here with Trump.
sentences.zh: 这个一贯投机取巧、总是在寻找他人弱点的人，在特朗普身上也如法炮制。

sentences.en: He could sense, I think, that the walls were closing in on him and that his life, his freedom were on the line.
sentences.zh: 我想他能感觉到，自己正陷入绝境，生命和自由都岌岌可危。

sentences.en: And he was desperate to find any edge, any advantage he could grab.
sentences.zh: 他迫切地想要抓住任何一点优势，任何他能利用的机会。

sentences.en: And one of those edges was Trump.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普就是其中之一。

sentences.en: It was this long ago relationship, but it still, in Epstein's eyes, had value to him as he tried to evade the criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 这是一段很久以前的关系，但在爱泼斯坦眼中，当他试图逃避刑事司法系统时，这段关系依然具有价值。

sentences.en: David, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，瑞秋。

sentences.en: After the break, I talked to our colleague Michael Gold about the fight on Capitol Hill over the Epstein files and the push to release even more documents.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我将与我们的同事迈克尔·戈尔讨论国会山上关于爱泼斯坦档案的争斗，以及推动公开更多文件的进展。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才你们听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: Michael Gold, thank you so much for joining us from what looks like a phone booth on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·戈尔，非常感谢你从国会山那个看起来像电话亭的地方加入我们。

sentences.en: Is that where you are?
sentences.zh: 你是在那里吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I'm in a phone booth, basically.
sentences.zh: 是的，我基本上就在一个电话亭里。

sentences.en: It's a closet, more or less.
sentences.zh: 准确地说，是个壁橱。

sentences.en: Well, thank you for finding a quiet space for us.
sentences.zh: 好吧，谢谢你为我们找到了一个安静的空间。

sentences.en: We wanted to talk to you after we've just talked to David Enrich about what we learned from these more than 20,000 pages worth of emails from Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 在与大卫·恩里奇讨论了我们从杰弗里·爱泼斯坦那两万多页邮件中了解到的信息后，我们想和你聊聊。

sentences.en: And I want to ask you, somebody who's been covering the saga from Capitol Hill,
sentences.zh: 我想请你，作为一名一直在国会山报道这一事件的记者，

sentences.en: to explain to us why these emails have been released and where exactly we are in the long journey of trying to get all of the Epstein files released.
sentences.zh: 向我们解释一下为什么这些邮件会被公开，以及在争取公开所有爱泼斯坦档案的漫长征程中，我们现在究竟处于什么阶段。

sentences.en: So the story here on Capitol Hill actually begins months ago in July.
sentences.zh: 国会山这边的故事其实早在几个月前的七月份就开始了。

sentences.en: And at the time, a lot of lawmakers here were very unhappy that the Trump administration had backtracked in their view on a promise to release the files.
sentences.zh: 当时，这里的许多议员对特朗普政府违背了公开这些档案的承诺感到非常不满。

sentences.en: And so two lawmakers, Representative Ro Khanna, a Democrat from California, and Thomas Massey, a Republican from Kentucky,
sentences.zh: 于是，两位议员——来自加利福尼亚州的民主党众议员罗·康纳和来自肯塔基州的共和党众议员托马斯·马西，

sentences.en: decide that they're going to introduce a bill that would force the Justice Department to release the Epstein files.
sentences.zh: 决定提出一项法案，强制司法部公开爱泼斯坦档案。

sentences.en: At the same time, there's a lot of skepticism that this bill will actually ever come to a vote.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，人们对这项法案能否真正付诸表决持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: And so Democrats on the House Oversight Committee use the committee to begin forcing subpoenas on the Epstein investigation.
sentences.zh: 因此，众议院监督委员会的民主党人利用该委员会开始强制执行针对爱泼斯坦调查的传票。

sentences.en: And it eventually expands to include Republicans who want to see additional subpoenas and are interested in getting more information released.
sentences.zh: 随后，调查范围扩大，包括了那些希望看到更多传票并有兴趣获取更多公开信息的共和党人。

sentences.en: So you have a bill that would force the Justice Department to release the files and an investigation coming out of the Oversight Committee that's a larger investigation into Jeffrey Epstein,
sentences.zh: 所以，现在既有一项强制司法部公开档案的法案，又有一个来自监督委员会的调查，这是一项关于杰弗里·爱泼斯坦、

sentences.en: Ghislaine Maxwell, and how the Trump administration handled the case.
sentences.zh: 吉丝莱恩·麦克斯韦以及特朗普政府如何处理此案的更大规模调查。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, there are two parallel efforts going on here.
sentences.zh: 为了明确起见，这里有两项平行的工作在进行。

sentences.en: One is to get the DOJ to release the files,
sentences.zh: 一项是促使司法部公开档案，

sentences.en: and the other one is from this House Oversight Committee to get more information about Jeffrey Epstein and his relationship to these powerful figures,
sentences.zh: 另一项是来自众议院监督委员会，旨在获取更多关于杰弗里·爱泼斯坦及其与这些权势人物关系的信息，

sentences.en: including President Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 包括唐纳德·特朗普总统。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And one telling detail, I think, about this whole saga that gets us to today is that Speaker Mike Johnson does not want to support this bill.
sentences.zh: 我认为，关于整个事件发展到今天，有一个耐人寻味的细节，那就是众议院议长迈克·约翰逊并不支持这项法案。

sentences.en: He opposes a bill that would force the Trump administration to do anything on the Epstein files.
sentences.zh: 他反对任何强制特朗普政府在爱泼斯坦档案上采取行动的法案。

sentences.en: But as he is opposing the bill, he points to this investigation the Oversight Committee is doing frequently and says, well,
sentences.zh: 但在反对该法案的同时，他经常提到监督委员会正在进行的这项调查，并说，好吧，

sentences.en: this is the avenue that we need to take if we want to get full transparency here.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想要实现完全透明，这才是我们应该采取的途径。

sentences.en: Okay, so the read on this is basically that Johnson is supportive of the House Oversight Committee's efforts,
sentences.zh: 好的，所以目前的解读基本上是，约翰逊支持众议院监督委员会的努力，

sentences.en: but not supportive of the efforts to force the DOJ to turn over other documents, right?
sentences.zh: 但不支持强制司法部移交其他文件的努力，对吧？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what ends up happening is the Oversight Committee gets all of these documents from Jeffrey Epstein's estate,
sentences.zh: 最终发生的情况是，监督委员会从杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的遗产中获得了所有这些文件，

sentences.en: and it's the information in those materials that they end up releasing today.
sentences.zh: 而他们今天公开的正是这些材料中的信息。

sentences.en: So let's just pause for a second.
sentences.zh: 让我们先暂停一下。

sentences.en: The Democrats released three emails first, before this trove of 20,000.
sentences.zh: 民主党人在这两万份文件之前，先公开了三封邮件。

sentences.en: So why did they choose to take that step?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要采取这一步？

sentences.en: So if you ask them, they'll tell you that they got these particular documents a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 如果你问他们，他们会告诉你，他们是几天前才拿到这些特定文件的。

sentences.en: It took them time to go through and redact information and decide that these needed to come out today.
sentences.zh: 他们花了一些时间来审阅、删减信息，并决定这些文件需要在今天公布。

sentences.en: That's the stated reason.
sentences.zh: 这就是官方给出的理由。

sentences.en: But I think there's also political dynamics at play, as there often are here on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 但我认为其中也存在政治博弈，就像国会山经常发生的那样。

sentences.en: Today is the day that the House is voting to end the government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 今天正是众议院投票结束政府停摆的日子。

sentences.en: And House Democrats are really unhappy with the deal that the Senate made.
sentences.zh: 众议院民主党人对参议院达成的协议非常不满。

sentences.en: They think it makes them look weak, that they didn't get what they wanted.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这让他们看起来很软弱，因为他们没有得到想要的结果。

sentences.en: And the release of these emails, intentionally or not, has changed and shifted the conversation on Capitol Hill so that the Epstein saga has become the focus again.
sentences.zh: 而这些邮件的发布，无论是有意还是无意，已经改变并转移了国会山的讨论焦点，使得爱泼斯坦事件再次成为关注中心。

sentences.en: But it's very clear that Republicans, President Trump and the White House,
sentences.zh: 但很明显，共和党人、特朗普总统和白宫，

sentences.en: all want to be talking about the fact that Republicans ended the shutdown without Democrats having to make major concessions.
sentences.zh: 都希望讨论共和党人在没有让民主党人做出重大让步的情况下结束了停摆这一事实。

sentences.en: And instead, a significant amount of their time today has been spent talking about Jeffrey Epstein and his relationship with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 然而相反，他们今天很大一部分时间都花在了讨论杰弗里·爱泼斯坦及其与特朗普总统的关系上。

sentences.en: So if Republicans had an incentive to keep the focus on the end of the shutdown, why did they then release 20,000-plus files on Jeffrey Epstein?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果共和党人有动力将焦点保持在停摆结束上，他们为什么还要发布两万多份关于杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的文件呢？

sentences.en: So earlier this morning,
sentences.zh: 今天早些时候，

sentences.en: House Republicans and the White House argued that Democrats were cherry-picking documents and selectively choosing documents from this trove in order to present a specific narrative.
sentences.zh: 众议院共和党人和白宫辩称，民主党人是在从这批文件中挑选文件，有选择性地发布，以呈现特定的叙事。

sentences.en: And so they released 20,000 documents from the Epstein estate to make the point that there's way more in the files than just these three emails.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们从爱泼斯坦遗产中发布了两万份文件，旨在说明档案中的内容远不止这三封邮件。

sentences.en: Throughout their investigation, House Republicans have been making the case that their Epstein investigation is not just about Trump,
sentences.zh: 在整个调查过程中，众议院共和党人一直试图证明，他们的爱泼斯坦调查不仅仅是针对特朗普，

sentences.en: but about a host of political elites and powerful figures, including President Clinton, who they repeatedly focused on.
sentences.zh: 而是针对包括克林顿总统在内的一系列政治精英和权势人物，他们反复强调了这一点。

sentences.en: But as we just learned from David Enrich,
sentences.zh: 但正如我们刚才从大卫·恩里奇那里了解到的，

sentences.en: the 20,000 documents did have a lot in there about President Trump and basically just like reinforce the idea that Epstein was fixated on Trump in many ways and raised a lot of questions about the relationship between these two men.
sentences.zh: 这两万份文件确实包含了很多关于特朗普总统的内容，基本上强化了爱泼斯坦在许多方面都盯着特朗普的想法，并引发了关于这两人关系的许多疑问。

sentences.en: So if the intent was for Republicans to detract attention away from the singular relationship between Trump and Epstein, it does not seem like that, at least today,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果共和党人的意图是转移人们对特朗普与爱泼斯坦这种特殊关系的关注，那么至少在今天看来，

sentences.en: had that desired effect.
sentences.zh: 并没有达到预期的效果。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think it was always going to be hard to change the focus away from Epstein's relationship with the president.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，想要改变人们对爱泼斯坦与总统关系的关注，本来就是一件很难的事情。

sentences.en: Because if you remember, how we got here in the first place is that the Justice Department,
sentences.zh: 因为如果你还记得的话，我们之所以走到这一步，是因为司法部，

sentences.en: after promising to release these files and insisting that they would release these files, decided not to.
sentences.zh: 在承诺公开这些档案并坚称会公开之后，最终决定不公开了。

sentences.en: And so there were always questions about Trump's relationship with Epstein and what might have been in the files.
sentences.zh: 所以，关于特朗普与爱泼斯坦的关系以及档案中可能包含的内容，一直存在疑问。

sentences.en: But there was a sense in which today was always going to be about Epstein in some way anyway.
sentences.zh: 但某种程度上，今天无论如何都注定会与爱泼斯坦有关。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: So seven weeks ago, an Arizona Democrat named Adelita Grijalva won a special election to fill a seat that was left vacant after her father died in office.
sentences.zh: 七周前，一位名叫阿德利塔·格里哈尔瓦的亚利桑那州民主党人赢得了一场特别选举，填补了她父亲在任上去世后留下的空缺席位。

sentences.en: And during her campaign, Grijalva said that as soon as she got to Capitol Hill, one of the first things she would do is sign on to this discharge petition.
sentences.zh: 在竞选期间，格里哈尔瓦表示，她一到国会山，要做的第一件事就是签署这份解除请愿书。

sentences.en: And that is the thing that you mentioned earlier, where if enough people sign on, they can force a vote that bypasses the speaker on whether or not to release the Epstein files,
sentences.zh: 这就是你之前提到的那件事，如果有足够多的人签名，他们就可以强制进行一次绕过议长的投票，决定是否公开爱泼斯坦档案，

sentences.en: correct?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: When Grijalva won, it looked like this petition might finally succeed.
sentences.zh: 当格里哈尔瓦获胜时，看起来这份请愿书终于可能成功了。

sentences.en: The problem was that when Grijalva won her election, the House was in recess.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，当格里哈尔瓦赢得选举时，众议院正在休会。

sentences.en: And Speaker Mike Johnson refused to seat her until the recess was over, which would not happen until there was a deal to end the shutdown.
sentences.zh: 而众议院议长迈克·约翰逊拒绝让她就职，直到休会结束，而这要等到达成结束停摆的协议后才会发生。

sentences.en: So obviously, Wednesday was the day that she was going to be seated.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，周三就是她将要就职的日子。

sentences.en: The shutdown was finally ending.
sentences.zh: 停摆终于要结束了。

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: So Speaker Johnson says that he'll swear Adelita Grijalva in at 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 众议院议长约翰逊表示，他将在周三下午4点为阿德利塔·格里哈尔瓦举行宣誓就职仪式。

sentences.en: on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 而这设定了最后期限。

sentences.en: And that sets the deadline.
sentences.zh: 此时，这份解除请愿书已经有了217个签名。

sentences.en: At this point, the discharge petition has 217 signatures.
sentences.zh: 格里哈尔瓦将成为第218位。

sentences.en: Grijalva would be the 218th.
sentences.zh: 在请愿书上的人中，有四位是共和党人。

sentences.en: Of the people on the petition, four of them are Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他们是托马斯·马西和三位共和党女性：南希·梅斯、劳伦·博伯特和玛乔丽·泰勒·格林。

sentences.en: That's Thomas Massey and three Republican women, Nancy Mace, Lauren Boebert, and Marjorie Taylor Greene.
sentences.zh: 本质上，这个下午4点的截止日期引发了白宫最后一刻的施压行动，他们几个月来一直在游说这些共和党人从请愿书上撤回他们的名字。

sentences.en: Essentially, this 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 但这没有奏效。

sentences.en: deadline kicks off a last-minute pressure campaign by the White House, who had been lobbying these Republicans for months to pull their names from the petition.
sentences.zh: 他们都表示会留在请愿书上。

sentences.en: But this doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 今天下午4点，

sentences.en: They all say they're going to stay on the petition.
sentences.zh: 阿德利塔·格里哈尔瓦宣誓就职。

sentences.en: And at 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 她完成仪式后做的第一件事就是签署了这份请愿书。

sentences.en: today, Adelita Grijalva gets sworn in.
sentences.zh: 那么接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: And the first thing she does after she finishes is signs this petition.
sentences.zh: 我们可能多快能真正看到司法部的这些文件？

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 这是这项工作中有趣的地方之一。

sentences.en: How quickly might we actually see the DOJ documents?
sentences.zh: 你知道，理论上，我们可能会在十二月的某个时候看到众议院的投票。

sentences.en: So that's one of the interesting things about this effort here.
sentences.zh: 根据议长决定如何操作，时间可能会更早。

sentences.en: You know, theoretically, we could see a vote on the House floor sometime in December.
sentences.zh: 但即使这项法案进入众议院并获得投票通过，这很可能会发生，因为它已经得到了众议院多数人的支持，

sentences.en: It could be earlier, depending on how the Speaker decides to maneuver here.
sentences.zh: 立法仍需提交给参议院，而参议院甚至可能永远不会审议它。

sentences.en: But even if this bill comes to the House floor and passes in a vote, which it probably will because it already has the support of the majority of the House,
sentences.zh: 如果它以某种方式在参议院获得通过，那么它将被送交总统，

sentences.en: the legislation would still have to go to the Senate, which might not even ever have to take it up.
sentences.zh: 从他的公开言论来看，很明显他可能会否决这项法案并将其退回国会。

sentences.en: And if it were to somehow get passed by the Senate, then it would get sent to the president,
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: who it seems very clear from his public remarks would probably veto this and send it back to Congress.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，这基本上可能会在参议院夭折。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 但即使它没有在参议院夭折，即使它送到了总统办公桌上，这样做又有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: So what you're saying is basically this could die in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 他不会推动这项法案的。

sentences.en: But even if it didn't die in the Senate, even if it got to the president's desk, what would the point of that be?
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: He's not going to push this through.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里许多人都在想的一个突出问题是，一旦这项努力显然会成功，白宫为什么要如此强烈地反对它。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a great question.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很大程度上与政治有关。

sentences.en: And I think one of the outstanding things that a lot of people here are wondering is why the White House whipped so hard against this once it became obvious that this effort would succeed.
sentences.zh: 让总统所在政党的成员投票支持一项本质上谴责其政府并试图强迫他们做他们坚称不会做的事情的法案，这对白宫来说是尴尬的。

sentences.en: I think a lot of this is about politics.
sentences.zh: 而且因为右翼阵营中有许多人一直在呼吁公开爱泼斯坦档案，所以人们一直有一种感觉，如果这件事真的付诸表决，

sentences.en: It's embarrassing to the White House to have members of the president's own party vote for a bill that essentially rebukes his administration and tries to compel them to do something that they insisted they wouldn't do.
sentences.zh: 那将不仅仅是一次简单的多数票表决，很多共和党人会觉得为了让他们的选民基础满意，他们别无选择，只能支持它。

sentences.en: And because so many on the right have been clamoring for the release of the Epstein files, there was always a sense that if this actually ever came to the floor,
sentences.zh: 这对共和党人和总统来说都是一个困难的处境，因为它让总统看起来正在失去本党成员的支持。

sentences.en: it would not be just a simple majority vote, but that a lot of Republicans would feel like they had no choice but to support it to keep their base happy.
sentences.zh: 显然，在华盛顿，共和党人违背特朗普总统意愿而遭到清洗的历史由来已久。

sentences.en: And that is a difficult position, both for Republicans and for the president to be in, because it makes it look like the president is losing favor with members of his own party.
sentences.zh: 但共和党人上周也刚刚输掉了一系列选举。

sentences.en: Obviously, there is a long history of Republicans who go against President Trump getting defenestrated from Washington.
sentences.zh: 总统的支持率非常低。

sentences.en: But Republicans also just lost a bunch of elections last week.
sentences.zh: 议员们非常清楚，杰弗里·爱泼斯坦是一个分裂了“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）运动和特朗普总统支持者的问题。

sentences.en: The president's approval is very low.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一个特朗普的许多支持者都希望实现高度透明的问题。

sentences.en: Lawmakers are very aware that Jeffrey Epstein is an issue that has divided the MAGA movement and President Trump's supporters.
sentences.zh: 那么，难道你不希望看到更多的共和党人投票支持公开这些文件吗？

sentences.en: And it's an issue where many of Trump's supporters want a lot of transparency.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们将看到比已经签署这项工作的四个人更多的共和党人投票支持公开这些文件。

sentences.en: So wouldn't you expect to see more Republicans voting to release these documents?
sentences.zh: 你说得对，议员们，尤其是国会山的共和党人，经常担心招致总统的愤怒，

sentences.en: I think we will see more Republicans than the four who have already signed on to this effort vote to release these documents.
sentences.zh: 特别是在我们进入中期选举和初选季节的时候。

sentences.en: You're right to say that lawmakers, especially Republicans on Capitol Hill, are often worried about invoking the wrath of the president,
sentences.zh: 但我认为这里有一个不同且重要的政治考量。

sentences.en: especially as we head into midterm elections and as we head into primary season.
sentences.zh: 一方面，是投票支持总统还是反对总统的问题。

sentences.en: But I think there's a different and important political calculation here.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，共和党人也不希望被视为记录下了一次保护杰弗里·爱泼斯坦免受进一步透明度审查的投票。

sentences.en: On the one hand, there's voting with the president and voting against the president.
sentences.zh: 但爱泼斯坦的故事一直没有消失，不是吗？

sentences.en: But on the other hand, Republicans don't want to be seen as recording a vote that would shield Jeffrey Epstein from further transparency.
sentences.zh: 这是一个一直困扰着特朗普总统的故事。

sentences.en: But the Epstein story just hasn't gone away, has it?
sentences.zh: 退一步说，我有点好奇你为什么会这么认为。

sentences.en: It is a story that has dogged President Trump.
sentences.zh: 为什么这是一个永远不会消失的故事？

sentences.en: And just to step back for a minute, I kind of wonder why you think that is.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的故事引发了许多关于特朗普总统竞选核心议题的质疑，

sentences.en: Why is this a story that just won't go away?
sentences.zh: 关于是否存在一个强大的精英集团，其利益被认为比人民的利益更重要。

sentences.en: The story of Jeffrey Epstein is one that prompts a lot of questions about the kind of things that President Trump has put at the heart of his campaign,
sentences.zh: 特朗普竞选时打出的口号是终结“深层政府”、清理“沼泽”。

sentences.en: about whether there is a powerful group of elites whose interests are perceived as being more important than the interests of the people.
sentences.zh: 但现在他掌权了，而他本人似乎正是那个在掩盖这些档案，不让美国人民看到真相的人。

sentences.en: Trump ran on a campaign of ending the deep state, of draining the swamp.
sentences.zh: 特朗普竞选时主打的口号是终结“深层政府”，清除腐败势力。

sentences.en: But now he's in charge, and he's the one who appears to be shielding these files and keeping them out of view of the American people.
sentences.zh: 但如今他大权在握，反倒成了那个似乎在掩盖这些文件、不让美国民众知情的人。

sentences.en: I think it's an example of a time when President Trump has tapped into these cultural forces.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个特朗普总统利用这些文化力量的例子。

sentences.en: But now that he's in the highest office of the land, they are turning in a direction that he didn't expect.
sentences.zh: 但现在他身居国家最高职位，事态的发展方向却出乎他的意料。

sentences.en: Michael, just to step back for a second and talk about the larger context this is all happening in.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我们先退一步，谈谈这一切发生的大背景。

sentences.en: It feels as though the lesson over and over again in recent elections has been that the electorate, the American people, care about affordability.
sentences.zh: 感觉近几届选举中反复出现的教训是，选民，也就是美国人民，关心的是负担能力。

sentences.en: They care about the cost of living.
sentences.zh: 他们关心生活成本。

sentences.en: They care about health care.
sentences.zh: 他们关心医疗保健。

sentences.en: We saw Democrats win big up and down the ballot recently, also about affordability in many respects.
sentences.zh: 我们看到民主党人最近在各级选举中大获全胜，在许多方面也都是因为负担能力问题。

sentences.en: President Trump won the most recent presidential elections in large part because people cared about the economy more than any other issues that the Democrats were pressing.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在最近的总统选举中获胜，很大程度上是因为人们关心经济胜过民主党人强调的任何其他议题。

sentences.en: So it feels really remarkable that after all of this, Democrats are focusing on Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 所以，在经历了这一切之后，民主党人竟然把焦点放在杰弗里·爱泼斯坦身上，这确实令人瞩目。

sentences.en: So what do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 那么，你是怎么看待这件事的？

sentences.en: I think for Democrats, they are connecting this issue to affordability.
sentences.zh: 我认为对民主党人来说，他们正在将这个问题与负担能力联系起来。

sentences.en: Personally, you know, they've been saying for a while that President Trump and Republicans are protecting the interests of elites, of billionaires,
sentences.zh: 就个人而言，你知道，他们一直以来都在说特朗普总统和共和党人是在保护精英阶层和亿万富翁的利益，

sentences.en: and that they're not looking out for the regular people.
sentences.zh: 而没有为普通民众着想。

sentences.en: And they see the Epstein issue as part of that, as another case of President Trump protecting billionaires rather than providing transparency that people really want.
sentences.zh: 他们将爱泼斯坦问题视为其中的一部分，认为这是特朗普总统保护亿万富翁，而不是提供人们真正想要的透明度的又一个案例。

sentences.en: But the other thing here is that this issue is one of the first times that Democrats have successfully been able to split Republicans and to divide some of them from President Trump.
sentences.zh: 但另一件事是，这个问题是民主党人第一次成功地分裂了共和党，并使其中一些人与特朗普总统产生分歧。

sentences.en: And so even though they just had these big wins in New Jersey and Virginia and New York that many attributed to a message of affordability,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管他们在新泽西州、弗吉尼亚州和纽约州刚刚取得了大胜，许多人将其归功于负担能力这一议题，

sentences.en: this is a case where they can't resist an opportunity to poke at the Republican Party, make them look weak, and put them on the defense.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个他们无法抗拒的机会，可以借此抨击共和党，让他们看起来软弱，并使他们处于守势。

sentences.en: Michael Gold, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·戈尔德，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The House gave final passage to a spending package to reopen the government, triggering the end to the longest-running shutdown in the nation's history.
sentences.zh: 众议院最终通过了一项旨在重启政府的支出方案，标志着美国历史上持续时间最长的政府停摆结束。

sentences.en: The vote came on day 43 of the shutdown and days after eight Democratic senators broke their own party's blockade and joined Republicans in allowing the spending measure to move forward.
sentences.zh: 投票是在政府停摆的第43天进行的，此前几天，八名民主党参议员打破了本党的封锁，加入共和党人的行列，允许支出法案继续推进。

sentences.en: It was the first time the House had held a vote in nearly two months.
sentences.zh: 这是众议院近两个月来首次举行投票。

sentences.en: And the American penny died on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 周三，美国一分硬币退出了历史舞台。

sentences.en: It was 232 years old.
sentences.zh: 它已经存在了232年。

sentences.en: The cause was irrelevance and expensiveness, the Treasury Department said.
sentences.zh: 财政部表示，原因是它已变得无关紧要且成本高昂。

sentences.en: Nothing could be bought anymore with a penny, not even penny candy, and the cost to mint the penny had risen to more than three cents.
sentences.zh: 现在一分钱什么也买不到，连一分钱糖果都买不到，而且铸造成本已经涨到了超过三美分。

sentences.en: The final pennies were minted on Wednesday afternoon in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 最后一批一分硬币于周三下午在费城铸造完成。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko, Alex Stern, and Rochelle Boncha.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗伯·齐普科、亚历克斯·斯特恩和罗谢尔·邦查制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Cowett and Lexi Diao.
sentences.zh: 由佩奇·考维特和莱克西·迪奥编辑。

sentences.en: It contains music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 节目配乐由丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛萨诺创作。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 录音工程由艾丽莎·莫克斯利负责。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是雷切尔·艾布拉姆斯。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在任何收听播客的平台上订阅。
